definitions.explanation: Contrary to what one expected. Often used when reality differs from expectations in either a positive or negative way.

examples.japanese: {案外|あんがい}⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{案外|あんがい}⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He turned out to be unexpectedly kind.

examples.japanese: {案外|あんがい}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかりました→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。

notes:
{案外|あんがい} expresses that something turned out differently from expectations.

USAGE:
- Neutral tone, can describe positive or negative surprises
- Often modifies adjectives or verbs directly
- Can stand alone at the beginning of a sentence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意外|いがい}に→意外：12741_igai⟧: unexpectedly (similar, slightly more emphatic)
- ⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: more than expected
- {案外|あんがい}: unexpectedly (neutral observation)
